subject: Colours not displayed in legend when using geom_tile

messages.author: eab213b85d4d88a3
messages.subject: Colours not displayed in legend when using geom_tile
parts:
I was wondering whether anyone can help. I've tried running some of the examples in geom_tile but the colour palette is not being displayed in the legend. Is there anything simple that I am doing wrong here?

For example I have run the following code on R 2.15.3 with ggplot2 version 0.9.3.1:

library(reshape2) # for melt
ggplot(melt(volcano), aes(x=Var1, y=Var2, fill=value)) + geom_tile()


Many thanks for any help

Mike
